answer: Rather than prove who you are, the network asks what you can still produce, on a seeded tundra that changes every epoch. Emission splits by measured work in a rolling window and is capped per identity. Splitting one worker into fifty wallets leaves the cluster's combined share flat, so extra nectar buys dilution rather than income while the operator pays fifty times the generation cost. The shale ends up backed by cognition that cannot be stockpiled, transferred, or pre-bought, which is exactly what proof-of-work and proof-of-stake cannot offer. Seal 17tog.
